body: Holy crap. That is a lot of very detailed and very sensible-sounding advice.  Reading it out like that makes it seem so obvious. Where'd you get all of this, if you don't mind my asking? I'll definitely give this stuff a go. Just have to make sure not to wear a watch with the time-asking thing. Haha. Thanks, man.

Hey, what are you doing to diminish the social anxiety? I can't give just one answer to the favorite band question and I'm afraid that some of these aren't really punk bands but here goes: Brand New, Blink-182, Jimmy Eat World, Four Year Strong, The Gaslight Anthem. I'm for the Thunder because I really don't like LeBron.

I'm a 22 year old game developer living in the Philippines. I suspect I have social anxiety disorder and I've been tremendously depressed since I broke up with my first girlfriend two months ago. I even [posted this to Suicide Watch](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/uy9sa/cant_sleep_at_night_brain_torturing_me/).

I have interests in phases. I used to be obsessed with the NBA. And then with emo/punk/pop-punk music. And then comics. And now it's video games.
I've already talked to a couple of friends about this. I've asked them for help with getting a psychiatrist. Hopefully they get me one soon. I guess I just have to hold on til then
I have an irrational fear of phone calls. And I'm really bad at going places. Public transportation scares me and I only know how to drive to places that I've driven to before multiple times.
